functions.name: writePackedPixel
functions.signature: (type $t14) (param $p0 i32) (param $p1 i32) (param $p2 i32) (param $p3 i32) (param $p4 i32) (param $p5 i32) (param $p6 i32) (param $p7 i32) (result i32)
functions.notes: Mode 1 alpha-blends with alpha^255, mode 2 saturates, mode 4 multiplies/255; all other modes copy the colour arguments.

validation.comparison: Every case asserts the call result and the written pixel at the computed address. 9 cases additionally assert all 67,108,864 memory bytes and the stack pointer. Coverage includes modes -1..8, wrapped 32-bit colour operands, source words, coordinates, strides and boundary traps.
limitations: Callers own surface descriptors and pixel addresses.
Mode 1 additions are not saturated, matching the original carry behaviour.
Two surface/pixel boundary cases trap identically.
Ledger: 339 client bodies recovered and 3,906 remain machine code.
